sections.title: About alerts
sections.intro:
An alert shows at the edge of a status bar only when it reaches its warn level or is active right now. The rest of the time it stays hidden. For example, the battery is low, Bluetooth is disconnected, rain is coming, or the UV or wind forecast reaches its warn level. Open an alert to choose which status bars show it, on the left or the right.

The warn level works on the graph too. Set the Visible values of a wind, gust or UV line to Alert (), and the line shows only in the hours that reach the warn level.

introNotes.text: By default, warn is at 100, the level of the US health standard for short-term exposure. Above it, the US EPA rates the air unhealthy for sensitive groups, such as children, older adults and people with heart or lung disease. Danger is at 150.
